dashboards.name: Limit up/down - orders on pinned stocks
dashboards.description: Every parent order, activated or not, sitting on a stock that was locked or one-sided for longer than the chosen threshold, with how long that lasted. Reads the same in real time and over a historical range: the period switch sends each dataset to the real-time or the historical side of its environment. Source of truth is limit_up_down_kmonitor.q; regenerate this file with build_dashboard.py rather than editing it.

parameters.name: min_mins
parameters.label: Minimum duration (minutes)
parameters.help: How long the stock has to have been locked or one-sided before it counts. This one is inside the query, so changing it goes back to the server.
